_about: Scout's weekly report: what's hot inside services people already pay for. Real, dated, sourced picks only. At most one pick per service per week. Refresh weekly (checked 2026-11-11, Wednesday run).

items.title: "Taken: Natalee Holloway" is Netflix's #1 English show
items.text: 12.9 million views in the week of Nov 2, the most of any English-language series. It's already in your Netflix plan.

items.title: "Housewife" by Tate McRae is #1 on Spotify worldwide
items.text: About 36 million streams in the week of Nov 5, top of the Spotify Global weekly chart. Free to play with your Spotify plan.
items.src: Spotify Global weekly chart via Soundcharts, week of Nov 5, 2026

items.title: "Percy Jackson and the Olympians" season 3 lands Nov 20
items.text: Two-episode premiere on Friday, Nov 20, with new episodes on Fridays after that. Included with Disney+.
items.src: Time Out, Everything coming to Disney+ and Hulu in November 2026

items.title: "12 12 12" heist drama starts Nov 13
items.text: Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan lead Apple TV's new heist series, out Friday, Nov 13. It's already in your Apple TV plan.
items.src: 9to5Mac, Everything new on Apple TV in November 2026
